title: Hamstring Strains — Rehab, Nordic Curls and Preventing the Next One

hook.en: Hamstring strains are the most common injury in sprinting sports such as cricket and football, and about one in five comes back. Good rehab is not rest and stretching: it is progressive, lengthening strength work and a careful return to high-speed running. Learn the plan that lowers re-injury.
hook.ur: Hamstring strain daurne wale khelon jaise cricket aur football mein sab se aam chot hai, aur takreeban paanch mein se ek dobara hoti hai. Achha rehab aaram aur stretching nahi: yeh barhta hua, lambai mein taqat ka kaam aur tez daurne mein ehtiyat se wapsi hai. Woh plan seekhein jo dobara chot ko kam karta hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll recognise a hamstring strain and its red flags, grade it clinically, progress loading from isometrics to eccentric and Nordic work, return the athlete to sprinting with clear criteria, and prescribe Nordic curls for prevention.
goal.ur: End tak aap hamstring strain aur is ke red flags pehchanenge, clinically grade karenge, loading ko isometrics se eccentric aur Nordic kaam tak barhayenge, khilari ko saaf criteria ke saath sprinting par wapas layenge, aur bachao ke liye Nordic curls likhenge.

text.en: Most hamstring strains happen during **high-speed running**, at the end of the swing phase when the muscle is **lengthening under load**, and most involve the **biceps femoris long head**. The athlete feels a sudden pain in the back of the thigh. Rehab moves through **protect → load → lengthen → sprint**. The single best-supported prevention tool is the **Nordic hamstring exercise**, which reduces hamstring injuries by about half when teams do it regularly.
text.ur: Aksar hamstring strain **tez daurne** ke dauran hote hain, swing phase ke aakhir mein jab muscle **load ke neeche lamba** ho raha hota hai, aur aksar mein **biceps femoris long head** shamil hota hai. Khilari ko thigh ke peeche achanak dard mehsoos hota hai. Rehab **hifazat → load → lambai → sprint** ki taraf barhta hai. Bachao ka sab se zyada saabit shuda tool **Nordic hamstring exercise** hai, jo teams ke baqaida karne par hamstring chot ko takreeban aadha kar deta hai.

text.en: A hamstring at top speed is like a **car's brakes on a steep hill**: it works hardest while it is being stretched, slowing the leg before the foot lands. Rehab must train the brakes **at speed and in a stretched position**, not only when the car is parked.
text.ur: Tez raftaar par hamstring **dhalwan par gaari ke brakes** jaisa hai: yeh sab se zyada mehnat tab karta hai jab khicha ja raha ho, paon zameen par lagne se pehle taang ko dheema karta hai. Rehab ko brakes ki training **raftaar par aur khichi hui position mein** karni chahiye, sirf khari gaari mein nahi.

steps.title: Protect and start moving (first days)
steps.detail: Avoid painful stretching and sprinting. Walk normally if possible, and start pain-free isometric contractions (heel pushes into the bed) and gentle bridges. || Hifazat aur harkat shuru (pehle din)

steps.title: Load and strengthen
steps.detail: Progress to single-leg bridges, Romanian deadlifts and hamstring curls, with mild pain (up to about 3 out of 10) that settles by the next day accepted. Start jogging when walking and light strength work are pain-free. || Load aur taqat

steps.title: Lengthen under load
steps.detail: Add eccentric and long-length work: Nordic curls (assisted at first), sliding leg curls and long-lever bridges, while building running speed in steps. || Load ke neeche lambai

steps.title: Return to sprint and sport
steps.detail: Return when the athlete can sprint at full speed without pain, has near-equal strength on both sides (for example at least 90 percent), full pain-free range and has completed full training with the team. || Sprint aur khel mein wapsi

question.en: In which phase of running do most hamstring strains happen?
question.ur: Daurne ke kis phase mein aksar hamstring strain hote hain?

feedback.en: Slow walking puts little strain on the hamstring.
feedback.ur: Aahista chalna hamstring par kam dabao daalta hai.
Us waqt load bohat kam hota hai.

text.en: Late swing, when the muscle lengthens under load to slow the leg
text.ur: Late swing, jab muscle taang ko dheema karne ke liye load ke neeche lamba hota hai

feedback.en: Yes — the hamstring works eccentrically at long length there.
feedback.ur: Haan — wahan hamstring lambi length par eccentric kaam karta hai.

rows.en: Strength work with mild, settling pain
rows.ur: Halke, theek ho jane wale dard ke saath strength ka kaam
Poori raftaar ke sprints, team training

text.en: **Long and fast.** The hamstring gets injured long and fast, so it must be trained long (eccentric, lengthened positions) and fast (progressive sprinting) before return.
text.ur: **Lamba aur tez.** Hamstring lamba aur tez hote hue zakhmi hota hai, is liye wapsi se pehle isay lamba (eccentric, khichi positions) aur tez (barhti sprinting) train karna zaroori hai.

text.en: **Returning on the calendar or when walking feels fine.** Feeling normal in daily life does not mean the muscle can cope with a sprint. Missing sprint exposure and eccentric strength are key reasons for re-injury.
text.ur: **Calendar par ya chalna theek lagne par wapsi.** Rozmarra zindagi mein normal mehsoos karne ka matlab yeh nahi ke muscle sprint sambhal sakta hai. Sprint ki mashq aur eccentric taqat ki kami dobara chot ki ahem wajah hain.

question.en: Which finding means the athlete is not ready to return to matches?
question.ur: Kaun si cheez batati hai ke khilari matches mein wapas aane ke liye tayyar nahi?

text.en: Pain and hesitation at 80 percent of sprint speed
text.ur: 80 percent sprint raftaar par dard aur jhijhak

feedback.en: Yes — full-speed sprinting without pain is a key criterion.
feedback.ur: Haan — dard ke baghair poori raftaar ki sprinting ahem criterion hai.

feedback.en: That is one of the return criteria.
feedback.ur: Yeh wapsi ke criteria mein se ek hai.

question.en: What is the Nordic hamstring exercise best known for?
question.ur: Nordic hamstring exercise kis liye sab se zyada mashhoor hai?

text.en: Reducing hamstring injury rates by about half in teams that do it regularly
text.ur: Baqaida karne wali teams mein hamstring chot ki shara ko takreeban aadha karna

feedback.en: Yes — it is the best-supported prevention exercise.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh sab se zyada saabit shuda bachao ki exercise hai.

text.ur: Hamstring ko passive tareeqe se khichna

feedback.en: It is a strong eccentric strength exercise, not a stretch.
feedback.ur: Yeh mazboot eccentric strength exercise hai, stretch nahi.

text.en: Being safe to do on day one of a strain
text.ur: Strain ke pehle din karne ke liye mehfooz hona

feedback.en: It is too demanding early; it comes in the later phases.
feedback.ur: Yeh shuru mein bohat mushkil hai; baad ke marahil mein aati hai.

text.en: **Start Nordics gently.** Nordic curls cause marked soreness the first week. Begin with 2 sets of 5 with a partner holding the ankles, lowering as slowly as possible and catching with the hands, then build over weeks to about 2 to 3 sets of 8 to 12, once or twice a week in season.
text.ur: **Nordics narmi se shuru karein.** Nordic curls pehle hafte mein kaafi soreness karte hain. Partner ke takhne pakarne ke saath 5 ke 2 sets se shuru karein, jitna ho sake aahista neeche aayein aur haathon se sambhalein, phir hafton mein takreeban 8 se 12 ke 2 se 3 sets tak barhayein, season mein hafte mein ek ya do baar.

question.en: When is a "hamstring strain" something more serious?
question.ur: "Hamstring strain" kab kuch zyada sangeen hota hai?

answer.en: A tear at the top of the muscle, where the tendon attaches to the sitting bone (proximal avulsion), may need surgery. Suspect it after a forceful hip flexion with knee straight (for example a water-skiing fall or a split), with a pop, large bruising, a gap or weakness, or sitting pain. Refer urgently for imaging and a surgical opinion, as early repair gives better results.
answer.ur: Muscle ke ooper wale hissay mein, jahan tendon baithne wali haddi se juda hai (proximal avulsion), tear ko surgery chahiye ho sakti hai. Seedhe ghutne ke saath hip ke zordar flexion ke baad (maslan water-skiing mein girna ya split) is ka shak karein, pop, bara neel, khala ya kamzori, ya baithne ke dard ke saath. Imaging aur surgical raye ke liye fori refer karein, kyunke jaldi marammat behtar nateeje deti hai.

beats.patient: A 22-year-old fast bowler felt a sharp pain in the back of his thigh while running in to bowl. He can walk with mild pain, there was no pop, and bruising is small. Strength and stretch are painful but not severely weak.
beats.assessment: The picture fits a moderate biceps femoris strain without signs of avulsion.
beats.treatment: Protect for a few days, then progressive loading (bridges, RDLs, curls), Nordic curls and graded running, with return when he sprints at full speed without pain and has 90 percent or more strength symmetry.
beats.reassess: He returns to bowling at week 6, keeps Nordic curls weekly in season, and has no recurrence that season.

text.en: **Refer urgently** if there was a pop with a large bruise, a palpable gap, marked weakness or sitting pain near the sitting bone (possible proximal avulsion). **Consider other causes** if the pain started without an injury, spreads below the knee with tingling (nerve or back origin), or the calf is hot and swollen (possible clot).
text.ur: **Fori refer karein** agar bare neel ke saath pop hua ho, mehsoos hone wala khala, numayan kamzori ya baithne wali haddi ke qareeb baithne ka dard ho (mumkina proximal avulsion). **Doosri wajah sochein** agar dard baghair chot ke shuru hua, ghutne se neeche jhunjhunahat ke saath phailta ho (nerve ya kamar se), ya pindli garam aur soojhi ho (mumkina clot).

summary.en: Most hamstring strains happen in late swing of high-speed running, when the muscle lengthens under load.
summary.ur: Aksar hamstring strain tez daurne ke late swing mein hote hain, jab muscle load ke neeche lamba hota hai.

summary.en: Rehab progresses protect → load → lengthen → sprint, and return depends on criteria (pain-free full-speed sprinting, about 90 percent strength), not the calendar.
summary.ur: Rehab hifazat → load → lambai → sprint ki taraf barhta hai, aur wapsi criteria par munhasir hai (dard-free poori raftaar sprinting, takreeban 90 percent taqat), calendar par nahi.

summary.en: Regular Nordic hamstring exercise roughly halves hamstring injuries; refer suspected proximal avulsions urgently.
summary.ur: Baqaida Nordic hamstring exercise hamstring chot ko takreeban aadha kar deti hai; mashkook proximal avulsion ko fori refer karein.

front.en: What suggests a proximal hamstring avulsion?

back.en: A pop, large bruise, gap or marked weakness, and sitting pain after forceful hip flexion.
back.ur: Zordar hip flexion ke baad pop, bara neel, khala ya numayan kamzori, aur baithne ka dard.
